mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, need_scheduling_time, product_id, need_quantity, scheduling_quantity, use_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_building_bo_chu_job_directory WHERE parent_id != -1 AND job_type = 1

SELECT * FROM mes_building_bo_chu_job_directory WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND job_type = 1 AND project_id = #{projectIdsStr} AND workshop_id = #{workshopId} AND team_code_id = #{teamCode} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM mes_building_bo_chu_job_directory WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND parent_id = -1 AND workshop_id = #{workshopIdStr} AND team_code_id = #{teamCode} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mes_building_bo_chu_job_directory( job_id, parent_id, job_name, job_type, project_id, workshop_id, team_id, team_code_id, task_order_id, steel_plate_type_enum ) VALUES ( #{param.jobId}, #{param.parentId}, #{param.jobName}, #{param.jobType}, #{param.projectId}, #{param.workshopId}, #{param.teamId}, #{param.teamCodeId}, #{param.taskOrderId}, #{param.steelPlateTypeEnum} )
mapper.select: SELECT label FROM sys_dictionary WHERE name = #{name} AND sort = #{sort} AND bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT ANY_VALUE(need.id) 'id', sum(need.need_quantity) 'scheduling_quantity', ANY_VALUE(DATE_FORMAT(need.scheduling_date, '%Y-%m-%d')) 'scheduling_date', ANY_VALUE(users.id) 'scheduling_user_id', ANY_VALUE(users.name) 'scheduling_user_name', ANY_VALUE(taskorder.id) 'task_order_id', taskorder.order_number 'order_number', min(need.ask_complete_time) artifactAskCompleteTime FROM mes_building_task_need_machine_part_scheduling need LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_order taskorder ON need.task_order_id = taskorder.id LEFT JOIN sys_user users ON need.scheduling_user_id = users.id WHERE need.nesting_job_id = #{jobId} AND need.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY taskorder.order_number

SELECT need.workshop_id workshopId, ANY_VALUE(workshop.name) 'workshop_name' FROM mes_building_task_need_machine_part_scheduling need LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON need.workshop_id = workshop.id AND workshop.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE need.bool_delete_enum = 0 group by need.workshop_id
mapper.update: UPDATE mes_building_bo_chu_job_directory SET bool_delete_enum = 1 WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.* FROM mes_building_team a INNER JOIN mes_building_team_user_link b ON a.id = b.team_id AND b.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE b.team_id = #{teamId} AND b.bool_leader_enum = 1

SELECT mbw.NAME workshopName, mbtul.user_name teamName, CASE WHEN tmp.steel_plate_type_enum = 1 THEN '板材' WHEN tmp.steel_plate_type_enum = 2 THEN '板材' WHEN tmp.steel_plate_type_enum = 4 THEN '型材' ELSE '未知类型' END AS type FROM mes_building_task_process mbtp LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop mbw ON mbtp.workshop_id = mbw.id AND mbw.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link mbtul ON mbtp.team_id = mbtul.team_id AND mbtul.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part tmp ON tmp.id = mbtp.product_id AND tmp.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbtp.machine_part_scheduling_id = #{dataId} AND mbtp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT mbtp.id, mbtp.project_id, mbtp.workshop_id, mbtp.task_order_id, mbto.order_number AS taskOrderNumber, steel.name AS partType, tmp.specification, tmp.material, tmp.thick, tmp.net_weight, tmp.length, CASE WHEN tmp.steel_plate_type_enum = ${@com.hzchum.scim.common.core.api.enums.SteelPlateTypeEnum@SECONDARY_MEMBER.getType()} and (tmp.surface_area = 0 OR tmp.surface_area IS NULL ) THEN tmp.length * tmp.width ELSE tmp.surface_area END AS surface_area, mbtp.need_quantity AS quantity FROM mes_building_task_process mbtp LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_order mbto ON mbtp.task_order_id = mbto.id AND mbto.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON mbtp.project_id = cp.id AND cp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part tmp ON tmp.id = mbtp.product_id AND tmp.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_steel_classification steel ON tmp.steel_id = steel.id AND steel.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND steel.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE mbtp.sequence = 0 AND mbtp.machine_part_scheduling_id = #{dataId}
